summary: Accept Fractal SCG read header and proof domain without changing writers

replay.detail: No replay or history rewriting; old signed bytes remain verifiable.

compatibility.detail: Additive reader only: x-fractal-scg-read-authorization aliases x-st3-scg-read-authorization; conflicting dual headers are refused. Proof envelopes may present domain fractal.scg-read.v1 or st3.scg-read.v1; an omitted domain retains st3.scg-read.v1. Signatures bind the presented domain exactly. Clients and the SCG attestor continue sending old names and bytes.

downtime.detail: No additional service interruption beyond deploying the accepting reader.

manual.detail: Deploy accepting readers fleet-wide before any later writer cutover. No action for existing clients.

recovery.detail: No durable state changes. Old clients remain compatible; restore old writers before downgrading a fleet that later switches writers.
